description.value: Uncle Lu Restaurant is a Taiwanese restaurant in Richmond, BC, known for home-style dishes like pork knuckle with sweet ginger dip and braised pork belly on rice. The menu spans traditional stir-fries, marinated meats, noodle soups, and classic Taiwanese street snacks in a cozy, unpretentious setting. It has built a local reputation as a hidden gem for those seeking authentic Taiwanese flavours.
